title: A Inheritance for the Autopsy
author: Lena Winterbourne
blurb: Paloma Lockridge, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
